card.name: Middle of multiword medical terms
card.fires_on: The second or middle piece of a multiword medical or anatomical term, just before the final noun, such as 'fusiform face', 'thyroid stimulating' or 'periodic limb movement'.

modes.label: Anatomy and brain terms
modes.description: Middle word of a named body structure or brain area, before 'area' or 'sulcus'.
modes.example: parts of the brain such as the fusiform<< face>> area dedicated to face processing

modes.label: Hormone and condition names
modes.description: Piece inside a hormone or disorder name, often split into parts, before the head noun.
modes.example: subnormal serum levels of thyroid<< stimulating>> hormone (TSH)

modes.label: Split medical adjectives
modes.description: Part of a long adjective or eponym split across pieces, before the noun it modifies.
modes.example: IMNM is characterized by: prox<<imal>> muscle weakness
